title: Prescribed-qbot local Jacobian error diagnosis
motivation: Global theta-tolerance tightening from 1e-5 to 3e-6 and 1e-6 did not recover the analytical B01:wet qbot Newton path and worsened iteration/backtracking counts. The representation error metric must therefore be diagnosed rather than globally densified.
question: Which local retention/capacity interpolation error in the actually visited pressure-head range changes the prescribed-qbot Newton path?
frozen_case: B01:wet, bottom_mode=2, qbot=1e-6 cm/day, dt=0.01 day
diagnostics: analytical and candidate initial-node theta and C differences
analytical and candidate final-node theta and C differences
maximum theta and C differences over all nodes
head locations of maximum theta and C differences
distance of visited heads to the h=-1 cm lookup/fallback seam
mass weight C*dz/dt difference at each node
candidate support interval containing each visited lookup-domain head
decision_rule: Use the diagnosed local quantity to define the next error metric. Do not introduce another global point-density sweep without a localized mechanism.
